# Metapackink

Metapackink is a custom packaging manufacturer for premium brands and consumer products.

## Website

- Homepage: https://www.metapackink.com/
- Products: https://www.metapackink.com/products.html
- Packaging Solutions: https://www.metapackink.com/packaging-solutions.html
- Contact Us: https://www.metapackink.com/contact.html

## Company Focus

Metapackink develops and manufactures custom packaging for luxury, beauty, fragrance, retail, gifting, jewelry, and other premium consumer products.

The company focuses on custom packaging development, manufacturing, quality control, and delivery coordination for brands and businesses seeking tailored packaging solutions.

## Packaging Solutions

Metapackink provides custom packaging services covering the process from structural development through production and delivery coordination.

- Structural development
- Material selection
- Artwork development
- Prototyping
- Premium finishing
- Mass production
- Quality control
- Inspection
- Delivery coordination

Common packaging materials and finishing options include greyboard, specialty paper, fabrics, protective materials, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, matte lamination, and soft-touch finishing.

## Industries and Applications

Metapackink provides custom packaging solutions for:

- Luxury products
- Cosmetics and beauty products
- Perfume and fragrance products
- Premium consumer products
- Jewelry
- Retail products
- Gifts and promotional products
